observations: Black mirrorless camera body with 'Canon' and 'EOS' branding on the top and front.
A 15-45mm lens is attached to the camera.
The camera is resting on its retail box.
The box is labeled 'EOS M50' and 'EF-M15-45 IS STM Kit'.
The lens barrel shows focal length markings (15, 18, 24, 28, 35).
The image contains a watermark 'GOODNESS CONNECT' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.claim: Produce incredible high-resolution, cinematic video footage

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or the image sensor may be scratched.
risks.proof: A video of the camera powering on and a clear photo of the sensor.

risks.risk: The lens may have internal fungus or significant optical defects.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens glass in both the wide and zoomed positions.

risks.risk: The shutter may be near the end of its life (high shutter count).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a recent image file.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the camera powered on showing the LCD screen.
Photo of the lens glass with the camera at a distance to check for fungus or haze.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by the model name on the box and the camera body. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state.
